documents.title: Returns
documents.text: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds take five business days after inspection.

documents.title: Delivery
documents.text: Standard shipping takes three to seven business days. Express shipping takes one to two business days. Change a delivery address before dispatch by contacting support. Track parcels using the tracking link in the dispatch email.

documents.title: Account security
documents.text: Reset your password using the account recovery page. Never share verification codes. Revoke active sessions immediately if your account is compromised. Enable two-factor authentication in security settings.

documents.title: Billing
documents.text: Download invoices and payment receipts from the billing dashboard. Duplicate charges require a payment review by support. Update your company tax number before requesting a revised invoice.

documents.title: Developer API
documents.text: API requests require a bearer token. Rate limits are 100 requests per minute per workspace. Responses with status 429 include a Retry-After header. Rotate API tokens in developer settings.
